title: Split hosts_enforcer.sh into mount and magisk halves, both tested to 100%
objective: Take hosts_enforcer.sh from 421 lines to under the repo's 250-line cap by extracting its bind-mount logic and its Magisk/cache-invalidation logic into two flat siblings, and cover both at 100%. This is the code that decides whether the DNS blocklist is actually enforced; a probe that reports an OEM overlay as our blocklist means no blocking at all while the status reads green.
acceptance_criteria: bash meta/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all no longer lists phone_focus_mode/hosts_enforcer.sh, and no new file is over the cap.
shell_coverage.sh reports 100.00% for BOTH hosts_mount.sh and hosts_magisk.sh from the single test entry point.
Every assertion is mutation-proofed with zero survivors. A mutation that proves equivalent must be resolved by removing the equivalent code, not by weakening the mutation.
Ordering is asserted where it is load-bearing: /system must be remounted ro after rw, and the immutable flag re-set after being dropped.
meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh reports every function verbatim, except any deliberately changed — for which behavioural equivalence must be demonstrated across every input state.
Both new siblings are added to BOTH of deploy.sh's hardcoded lists, and the two lists remain in exact correspondence with no orphan in either direction.
shellcheck passes on each touched file individually, with no -x and no disable directive; sh -n passes on all three phone-side scripts.
No eval is introduced in test code.
out_of_scope: Deploying to the phone or verifying on-device; there is no device in this session.
Splitting verify_and_restore or main out of the entry script, which is under the cap without the two extracted halves.
Adding the siblings to deploy.sh's chmod list: they are sourced, not executed, matching dns_iptables.sh, tether_iptables.sh and curfew_net.sh.
Changing which domains are blocked or how the canonical blocklist is generated.
verifier: bash phone_focus_mode/lib/tests/test_hosts_libs.sh (expects 69 passed, 0 failed), plus shell_coverage.sh at 100.00% for hosts_mount.sh and hosts_magisk.sh, plus the mutation run at 17 killed / 0 survived, plus check_file_length.sh --all showing 19 files, plus deploy-list parity showing no orphans, plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files.
